INSERT INTO cache_change_log (domain, keys)
        SELECT r.domain,
               ARRAY(SELECT e.key
                     FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(r.keys) WITH ORDINALITY AS e(key, n)
                     ORDER BY e.n)
        FROM unnest($1::text[], $2::jsonb[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS r(domain, keys, n)
        ORDER BY r.n
